messages:
Rae (presales): Heads-up: MerchantCo wants a fast POC: WebSocket streaming, tool/function calls (server-initiated callbacks), and strict JSON schema output. They also flagged SSO (SAML) + customer-managed keys and asked for a pricing sketch for ~120k req/day and 60 concurrent streams. Can eng/solutions/security triage?
Hugo (eng): We can do WS with subprotocol support for tool-calls. Server-initiated tool calls arrive as messages with an id; client must respond with a tool_result. I'll prepare a minimal Go example.
Rae (presales): Go SDK would be ideal for them. Also they need session resume semantics for flaky mobile connections.
Samir (solutions): Resume is supported via a resume_token returned by handshake. On reconnect, if client presents resume_token we replay outstanding events and rehydrate the KV cache. We'll document limits (resume window 30m, cache size cap).
Fiona (security): CMEK for Hosted requires enterprise onboarding + procurement review; Private supports direct HSM integration. Request: MerchantCo to provide KMS vendor + key policy and their SAML metadata. Also need the filled security questionnaire (I sent link).
Jon (sales-ops): Quick pricing ballpark: Hosted (~120k req/day, avg 200 tokens/request) => ~$11k-$25k/mo depending on model family and quantization. Dedicated reserved node estimate ~ $15k/mo but gives lower per-token cost; can include a 30-day POC credit. I'll include EU region uplift and egress Mbps estimate.
Hugo (eng): Go example snippet: ```
ws, _ := websocket.Dial("wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream", "redwood.v1.toolcall", nil)
handshake := map[string]interface{}{
  "type":"handshake",
  "client_id":"merchantco-poc",
}
ws.WriteJSON(handshake)
// Server toolcall: {"type":"tool_call","id":"t1","name":"fetch_tx","args":{}}
// Respond: {"type":"tool_result","id":"t1","result":{...}}
```
Rae (presales): They also care about structured output guarantees: what happens if model emits invalid JSON?
Samir (solutions): Runtime will run schema validation. On failure we return a structured error with a short failure snippet and an automaton suggestion. For POC we'll enable a deterministic reformat attempt (same prompt + stricter schema hint) and then fallback to annotated text if that fails. We'll include a sample prompt template that improves serialization.
Fiona (security): Audit logging: for Hosted we can provide token-level logs for enterprise accounts and include trace IDs in logs. For Private customers they control log retention. Action: MerchantCo to provide list of admins and compliance contact.
Jon (sales-ops): I'll produce a comparison table: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, with cost, SLA, CMEK availability, and provisioning lead time. Also will include invoice cadence options (net-30/45/60) and a draft PO template for procurement.
Rae (presales): Nice. Also they asked for ephemeral token rotation sample (they want to run the refresh endpoint in their infra). Can we hand over a tiny server snippet?
Hugo (eng): Yep, we have a Node/Go token proxy snippet. For security, advise short TTLs (15m) and a refresh endpoint that validates client auth. I'll attach the snippet to the runbook.
Samir (solutions): POC runbook will include: handshake & resume flow, token rotation pattern, telemetry headers (trace_id, session_id in each message), schema validation flow, success criteria (schema pass >= 99.5%, toolcall RTT < 350ms p95, session-resume verified).
deploy-bot: canary deploy streaming-handler v2.3 to europe completed 3894a8
Rae (presales): Timeline: Hugo to post Go sample + resume example by Mon EOD, Samir to post runbook + schema templates Tue AM, Jon to share pricing/PO by Tue afternoon, Fiona to confirm questionnaire missing items. I'll schedule a sync with MerchantCo for Wed. :calendar: 
Hugo (eng): Will also add a small load harness that simulates 60 concurrent streams and validates schema pass rate.
Jon (sales-ops): I'll include bandwidth/egress assumptions and a note on burst capacity pricing.
Fiona (security): Sent the KMS questionnaire link; waiting on MerchantCo. Once we have SAML metadata we'll validate the SSO flow.
Rae (presales): Great work team 44d. I'll update MerchantCo after we have the artifacts.
